description: This Kotlin file defines a composable UI component for an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It manages the UI for an onboarding home screen with tabs for connecting, chatting, voice, screen sharing, and settings, including status indicators and navigation logic.

classes.name: HomeTab
classes.description: Enumeration representing different home screen tabs with labels and icons.

classes.name: StatusVisual
classes.description: Enumeration representing various connection statuses for visual indication.

methods.name: PostOnboardingTabs
methods.description: Main composable function rendering the onboarding tabs with associated content and status bar.

methods.name: ScreenTabScreen
methods.description: Composable rendering the screen tab's content, refreshing data when connected.

methods.name: TopStatusBar
methods.description: Displays a top status bar with connection info and status indicator.

methods.name: BottomTabBar
methods.description: Renders the bottom navigation tab bar allowing tab switching.
